runbooks.title: Roll back checkout-api to the previous version
runbooks.strategy: rolling, one pod at a time
preconditions: Previous version passed checks in the last 30 days
No schema migration in the current version
steps: Roll pods one at a time (batch 1)
Watch p99 and error rate per batch

runbooks.title: Runtime config override with rolling restart
runbooks.strategy: override the key at runtime, then rolling restart
preconditions: Override is recorded in the audit log
Override has an expiry of 72 h or less
steps: Restart pods one at a time
Remove override when the fix ships
